title: Business Development Executive (BDE)
description:
**Business Development Executive – EdTech**

**Company Name:** LMES Academy Private Limited  
**Website:** https://lmes.in/  
**LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/company/lmes-academy/mycompany/  
**Job Location:** Urapakkam, Chennai, Tamil Nadu  
**Experience:** 0–2 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Interview Mode:** Virtual

**About LMES Academy**

LMES Academy Private Limited is an EdTech organization focused on making science and technology learning engaging, practical, and accessible. Through STEM-based educational programs, we help students develop conceptual understanding, creativity, critical thinking, and future-ready skills.

Our educational initiatives include Chitti Future School, Chitti Experience Center, Chitti Play School, and Chitti NEET/JEE, offering learning opportunities across STEM, coding, artificial intelligence, robotics, early childhood education, and competitive exam preparation.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an enthusiastic and results-driven **Business Development Executive** to join our EdTech team. The candidate will engage with parents and students through virtual counselling sessions, understand their learning requirements, explain our educational programs, and guide them through the enrollment process.

This role is ideal for freshers and professionals with up to three years of experience who have strong communication skills, a passion for sales, and an interest in education and technology.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct online counselling sessions with parents and students through Google Meet to explain our educational programs.
* Understand students’ learning needs and recommend suitable STEM and technology-focused courses.
* Build positive relationships with prospective customers and address their queries effectively.
* Manage the complete sales cycle, from lead engagement and counselling to successful enrollment.
* Follow up with prospective customers through calls, WhatsApp, emails, and virtual meetings.
* Achieve weekly, monthly, and quarterly sales and enrollment targets.
* Maintain accurate lead information, customer interactions, and follow-up activities in the CRM.
* Handle customer objections professionally and support informed enrollment decisions.
* Stay updated on product offerings, market trends, and competitor activities.
* Ensure a professional counselling experience and high standards of customer satisfaction.

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline is mandatory.
* Candidates from Science, Electronics, or Engineering backgrounds will be preferred.
* Strong verbal communication skills in English and Hindi or Telugu are required.
* Freshers with excellent communication skills and an interest in sales are encouraged to apply.
* Candidates with experience in EdTech, inside sales, counselling, telecalling, or business development will have an added advantage.
* Good interpersonal, negotiation, persuasion, and relationship-building skills.
* Confidence in conducting virtual meetings and explaining educational programs.
* A target-oriented mindset with strong follow-up and closing skills.
* Basic knowledge of CRM tools, Google Workspace, and MS Office is preferred.
* A proactive attitude, willingness to learn, and passion for education and technology.

**Work Schedule**

* **Working Days:** 6 days a week
* **Mandatory Working Day:** Sunday
* **Fixed Weekly Off:** Thursday
* **Work Timings:** 1:30 PM to 10:30 PM
* **Flexibility:** Working hours may be extended depending on business requirements.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Competitive salary with attractive, uncapped performance-based incentives.
* Comprehensive training and onboarding.
* Performance-based career growth and promotion opportunities.
* Continuous learning and professional development.
* Exposure to innovative educational products and emerging technologies.
* Collaborative work culture with leadership support and mentoring.
* Employee engagement activities, rewards, and recognition programs.
* An opportunity to contribute to students’ learning and future development.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for candidates who are confident communicators, customer-focused, persuasive, and motivated to achieve sales targets. The ideal candidate should be comfortable interacting with parents and students, handling follow-ups, and working in a performance-driven environment.

**Interested candidates can apply with their updated resume.**

**Company LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/company/lmes-academy/mycompany/

title: Executive to the Chairman – Special Projects, Business Execution & Transformation
description:
Executive to the Chairman – Special Projects, Business Execution &

Transformation

Company: Spartek Group

Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu

Experience: 3–5 Years

Qualification: Engineering Graduate preferred; MBA or management

qualification is an added advantage.

About Spartek Group

Spartek Group is a diversified business group with a legacy spanning over four

decades, with interests across building materials, ceramics, sanitaryware,

precast concrete solutions, industrial and decorative flooring, construction

chemicals, and consumer tableware.

Through its various businesses and brands, including Spartek Tiles, Neycer

Sanitaryware, Spartekoncrete and UNIFORT, the Group is focused on

expanding its market presence, strengthening manufacturing and operational

capabilities, developing new business opportunities, and adopting technology-

driven solutions to improve business performance.

As the Group continues to pursue new growth opportunities and business

transformation initiatives, it offers an entrepreneurial environment for

professionals who are keen to work closely with senior leadership, take

ownership of challenging assignments, and contribute directly to business

growth.

About the Role

Spartek Group is looking for a dynamic, entrepreneurial and execution-

oriented professional to work directly with the Chairman on strategic

initiatives, special projects, business development, operational improvements

and organisational transformation.

This is a high-ownership, cross-functional role that provides exposure to

multiple business verticals, including manufacturing, sales and marketing,

finance, human resources, technology, digital transformation and new

business development.

1The individual will be responsible for converting the Chairman’s priorities and

business ideas into actionable plans and ensuring their successful

implementation. The role requires someone who is equally comfortable

analysing business opportunities, coordinating with senior management,

visiting manufacturing facilities, working with frontline teams and personally

driving projects to completion.

This is not a conventional desk-based corporate strategy role. We are looking

for someone who can move beyond planning and presentations to deliver

tangible, measurable business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

* Chairman’s Special Projects: Drive priority assignments, new initiatives

and strategic projects from conception through implementation and

closure.

* Business Development: Evaluate new products, markets, customer

segments and business opportunities; support commercial proposals,

market research and business launches.

* Manufacturing and Operations: Identify opportunities to improve

productivity, quality, cost efficiency, inventory management,

procurement and operational processes.

* Finance and Commercial Analysis: Support budgeting, cost monitoring,

working capital improvements, financial reporting and business

performance analysis.

* Technology and AI: Identify and implement practical applications of AI,

automation, ERP, CRM, dashboards and digital tools to improve

productivity and decision-making.

* Cross-Functional Coordination: Work closely with business heads, plant

teams, sales, finance, HR, IT, procurement and external stakeholders to

ensure timely execution.

* Project Monitoring: Establish milestones, timelines, budgets,

performance indicators and progress reports to monitor implementation

and results.

* Organisational Improvement: Support recruitment, performance

measurement, process standardisation, accountability and change

management initiatives.

2Candidate Profile

* 3–5 years of relevant experience in project execution, business

operations, business development, manufacturing, consulting with

hands-on implementation, or business transformation.

* Engineering degree preferred, particularly in Mechanical, Industrial,

Civil, Electrical or related disciplines.

* MBA or a management qualification in Operations, Finance, Strategy,

Marketing or General Management is an added advantage.

* Experience in building materials, manufacturing, consumer products,

homeware, FMCG, distribution or allied industries is desirable.

* Strong analytical, commercial and problem-solving skills.

* Good working knowledge of Excel, PowerPoint, project management

tools and business reporting.

* Practical familiarity with AI tools, automation and digital applications.

* Excellent communication, stakeholder management and coordination

skills.

* Willingness to travel to factories, warehouses, customer locations and

other Group offices as required.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a professional with an entrepreneurial mindset, a strong

sense of ownership, a bias for action and the ability to work independently in a

fast-paced business environment.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with ambiguity, learning

unfamiliar business processes, solving ground-level problems and taking

responsibility for outcomes.

Candidates who have personally implemented projects and delivered

measurable results will be preferred over those whose experience is primarily

limited to analysis, presentations or recommendations.

Career Development

This role offers direct exposure to the Chairman and the opportunity to

understand and contribute to multiple businesses within Spartek Group.

Based on demonstrated performance, the individual may progress into roles

such as Special Projects Manager, Business Operations or Transformation

3Manager, New Business Initiative Lead, or Business Development/Operations

Head for a business unit.

The position is particularly suited to professionals who aspire to develop into

future business leaders by combining analytical ability, commercial

understanding, technology orientation and hands-on execution.

Application Process

Interested candidates are requested to share their updated CV along with brief

details of two or three projects or initiatives they have personally

implemented. Applications should highlight the candidate’s individual

contribution, challenges addressed and measurable outcomes achieved.

If you are someone who takes ownership, enjoys solving real business

problems and wants to build businesses rather than simply manage tasks, we

would like to hear from you.

Pay: ₹55,000.00 - ₹65,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Manager – B2B Sales & Strategic Partnerships
description:
**Company:** Loan2grow Fincap Pvt. Ltd.  
**Function:** Business Development, Sales & Partnerships  
**Location:** Bengaluru, Delhi NCR, Chennai, Mumbai or Hyderabad  
**Experience:** 5–10 years  
**Role type:** Full-time | Target-driven

About Loan2grow

Loan2grow is an NBFC fintech focused on expanding access to responsible financing and financial services for underserved and working populations. Through products such as Earnplus, we aim to make financing and financial well-being solutions more accessible to gig workers, salaried employees, contractual workers and other underserved segments.

We are expanding our B2B distribution and institutional financing business by partnering with platforms, staffing companies, MSMEs and corporates.

Role purpose

We are looking for a commercially driven professional to build and grow Loan2grow’s B2B business across two channels:

* **Platform and employer partnerships:** Enable platforms, MSMEs and corporates to provide suitable financing and financial products to their workers and employees.
* **Direct institutional financing:** Develop financing opportunities with eligible MSMEs and corporates seeking funding for their businesses.

The person will own the business development cycle end-to-end, from prospect identification and relationship building to commercial negotiations, agreement closure, onboarding and portfolio activation.

This is a hands-on, revenue-oriented role for someone who can open doors, build a strong pipeline, close partnerships and translate signed agreements into actual business.

Key responsibilities1. B2B sales and partnership development

* Identify and acquire platform, staffing, MSME and corporate partners across priority sectors.
* Build relationships with founders, promoters, business heads, CHROs, HR leaders, CFOs, finance heads and other decision-makers.
* Develop and execute a structured sales pipeline, including prospecting, lead qualification, meetings, proposals, negotiations and closures.
* Position Loan2grow’s financing and financial services in terms of business value, workforce needs and partner economics.
* Develop partnerships with organisations employing or engaging large numbers of gig, blue-collar, contractual and salaried workers.

2. Employee and workforce financing partnerships

* Identify employers and platforms where employees or workers could benefit from appropriate financing and financial products.
* Work with partner HR, payroll and operations teams to design practical onboarding and employee communication processes.
* Coordinate with internal teams to assess payroll-linked repayment, authorised deduction mechanisms and other permitted repayment arrangements.
* Drive employee awareness, eligible-user onboarding, activation, repeat usage and partner engagement.
* Monitor partner performance and develop plans to improve adoption and portfolio quality.

3. Direct institutional financing

* Identify eligible MSMEs and corporates with potential financing requirements.
* Build relationships with business owners, promoters, CFOs and finance teams.
* Understand the institution’s business model, financing purpose, cash flows, repayment capacity and funding requirements.
* Coordinate collection of business, financial, banking, ownership and other documents required for credit assessment.
* Work closely with Loan2grow’s credit, risk, compliance and operations teams to progress proposals through the assessment and sanction process.
* Manage borrower communication, commercial discussions and post-disbursement relationship development.

*Credit approvals and sanctions will remain subject to Loan2grow’s authorised credit and risk processes.*

4. Commercial negotiations and execution

* Prepare partnership proposals, business cases and commercial models.
* Negotiate pricing, revenue-sharing arrangements, service expectations and operating workflows within approved company policies.
* Coordinate agreements, implementation plans, integrations and partner onboarding.
* Ensure that signed agreements translate into operational partnerships and measurable business outcomes.

5. Pipeline management and reporting

* Maintain an accurate CRM or sales tracker covering prospects, opportunity value, stage, next action and expected closure.
* Develop monthly and quarterly business plans and sales forecasts.
* Track conversions from leads to meetings, proposals, signed agreements, activated partners and financing disbursements.
* Report pipeline risks, market feedback, competitor activity and product or process improvements to senior management.

Key performance indicators

Performance will be evaluated on business outcomes, not merely meetings or signed MoUs.

* Qualified B2B pipeline generated and maintained.
* New partnerships and institutional financing relationships acquired.
* Conversion rate from qualified leads to signed agreements and funded accounts.
* Value and volume of financing originated and disbursed, measured separately for employee financing and institutional financing.
* Number of partners activated and eligible users onboarded.
* Utilisation and transaction activity across activated partnerships.
* Portfolio quality and repayment performance of originated business, in coordination with the credit and risk teams.
* Partner retention, repeat business and revenue contribution.
* Accuracy of pipeline reporting and timely execution of agreed milestones.

Specific targets will be established with management based on the approved business plan, product economics and the initial market-development period.

Desired candidate profile

* 3–4 years of experience in B2B sales, enterprise partnerships, fintech, lending, financial services, HR-tech, workforce solutions or MSME banking.
* Demonstrated experience in acquiring clients, negotiating commercial agreements and closing revenue-generating business.
* Existing relationships with platforms, staffing firms, MSMEs, corporates or employer networks will be an advantage.
* Understanding of lending, employee financial services, payroll processes or business financing is desirable.
* Ability to understand business models, assess commercial opportunities and coordinate with credit and risk teams.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship-management skills.
* Comfort with sales targets, pipeline reporting, field meetings and regular follow-ups.
* High ownership, accountability, execution discipline and willingness to build a business from the ground up.

What success looks like

Within the first 90 days, the person should have developed a prioritised target-account list, established a qualified pipeline, initiated substantive discussions with potential partners and borrowers, and progressed suitable opportunities towards closure.

Over time, success will mean building a repeatable B2B acquisition engine that generates active partnerships, sustainable financing volumes and good-quality business.

Why join Loan2grow?

* Build a growing B2B financing and financial-services business.
* Work directly with senior management on business development and market expansion.
* Develop partnerships across platforms, employers and the MSME ecosystem.
* Take end-to-end ownership of commercial outcomes and contribute directly to business growth.

How to apply

Interested candidates should share their CV along with a brief note on their B2B sales experience, the sectors and clients they have worked with, and examples of partnerships or financing business they have successfully originated and closed.

Application Question(s):

* 1. Relevant B2B sales experience

* Works with sales leader to ensure understanding of sales strategy and effective implementation of this strategy for the segment.

* Reviews sales and catering guest satisfaction results to identify areas of improvement.

description:
**Job Description – Senior Accounts Executive**

**Company:** Consulting & Beyond  
**Location:** Kilpauk, Chennai  
**Experience:** 3–10 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Job Summary**

**We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Senior Accounts Executive to independently manage the company's complete accounting operations, financial records and statutory compliance. The candidate will be responsible for maintaining the books of accounts, GST and TDS filing, bank reconciliation, payroll payment processing, invoice management and monthly financial closing.**

Key Responsibilities

* **Complete Accounting Operations:** Independently manage day-to-day accounting activities and maintain complete books of accounts, including ledger entries, journal entries, receipts, payments and expense records.
* **GST Compliance:** Handle GST calculations, reconciliation, return preparation and timely filing of applicable GST returns. Ensure accurate records and compliance with statutory requirements.
* **TDS Compliance:** Calculate TDS, prepare workings, make necessary payment arrangements, reconcile TDS records and ensure timely filing of applicable TDS returns.
* **Income Tax Compliance:** Handle company income tax-related accounting, maintain supporting records, coordinate for tax payments and support income tax return preparation and compliance requirements.
* **Bank Reconciliation:** Prepare Bank Reconciliation Statements (BRS) regularly, verify bank transactions and resolve discrepancies.
* **Invoice Processing & Payment Follow-up:** Prepare sales invoices, process purchase and expense invoices, track outstanding payments and follow up with clients or concerned parties for collections and settlements.
* **Petty Cash Management:** Maintain petty cash records, record daily transactions, verify supporting bills and vouchers, and monitor cash balances.
* **Payroll & Salary Payment Processing:** Prepare monthly salary payment workings, coordinate payroll-related accounting entries and process salary payments accurately and on time.
* **Accounts Payable & Receivable:** Monitor vendor payments, customer receipts, outstanding balances and account reconciliations. Ensure timely recording and settlement of transactions.
* **Monthly Closing & Reporting:** Complete monthly book closure, review ledgers and expenses, reconcile balances, and prepare monthly financial statements, expense summaries and MIS reports as required.
* **Documentation & Audit Support:** Maintain proper accounting records, vouchers, invoices, bank statements and statutory documents. Support internal and external audits and provide records when required.
* **Overall Accounts Management:** Take ownership of the company's accounting function, ensure accuracy of financial records, monitor compliance deadlines and coordinate with management, banks, auditors and external consultants whenever necessary.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* B.Com / M.Com / MBA Finance or an equivalent qualification.
* 3–6 years of relevant experience in end-to-end accounting operations.
* Strong practical knowledge of GST, TDS, income tax-related compliance and statutory filings.
* Hands-on experience in Tally Prime and MS Excel.
* Practical experience in BRS, complete books of accounts, monthly closing, invoicing and payment processing.
* Knowledge of payroll and salary payment processing, petty cash, accounts payable and receivable.
* Ability to independently manage accounting operations with minimal supervision.
* Strong attention to detail, time management and organizational skills.

**Job Description:**

**The opportunity:**

The candidate will join the CPQ (Configure Price Quote) team at INOPC – Chennai, contributing to the digitalization, productivity enhancement, and overall efficiency of the Sales CPQ process. This role focuses on driving solution development, ensuring adoption, and maintaining strong governance across the Sales CPQ ecosystem.

The candidate will collaborate closely with GPMM to develop and prioritize implementation activities aligned with the sales configurator roadmap for the GIS/PASS or Capacitor Banks/MECB portfolio. The role involves continuous coordination with global stakeholders and production units to support the implementation of configurators for new and existing products, Transfer of Products (ToP), and new production units.

The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong technical and analytical skills to enhance configurator coverage, along with solid project management capabilities to effectively plan, monitor, and coordinate activities. They will translate business needs into well‑defined user stories for the software development team, supported by a strong understanding of products and business processes.

**How you’ll make an impact:**

* Lead digitalization initiatives within the Sales community using platforms such as SFDC, Sales Configurator, PowerShop, and related tools.
* Drive change management activities by understanding current processes and identifying improvement opportunities.
* Serve as the key technical interface between software development teams, subject matter experts, and end users.
* Translate business requirements into clear user stories and functional specifications for development.
* Maintain strong understanding of business processes and product lines to support solution design.
* Provide technical support during gap analysis and liaise effectively with developers.
* Prioritize business cases and gap‑analysis requirements to optimize delivery effectiveness.
* Conduct training sessions for key users and general users to support adoption.
* Collaborate with implementation managers to create and maintain a high‑level roadmap and ensure milestone achievement.
* Maintain well‑defined configurator scope documentation for each production unit and product line.
* Coordinate implementation activities for new production units or new product introductions within existing units.
* Validate configurator outputs through test cases prior to release to ensure quality and accuracy.
* Ensure governance mechanism to monitor the adoption of sales configurator.
* Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
* Living Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

**Your Background:**

* Proven experience in technical business analyst in software projects using Agile methodology.
* Minimum of 7 years of relevant industry experience.
* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering is preferred and considered a strong advantage.
* Strong communication and technical writing skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint); SharePoint expertise preferred.
* Experience with tools such as Salesforce and SAP is an added advantage.
* Prior experience in software delivery projects is essential.
* Exposure to high‑voltage product sales or design is a significant plus.

title: Application Engineer
description:
Advantest India Private Limited, Chennai, India based subsidiary of Advantest Corporation, the world's largest provider of automated test equipment (ATE) to the semiconductor industry. We lead the way in developing new and innovative test and handling solutions for the global electronics industry.
  
  
We value ethical action in all our endeavors. Integrity is a critical component of who we are and what we do. We also value truthful communication. We strive to build trusting relationships with our employees, customers, and partners which have a positive influence in creating winning results. Recognition for individual and team achievement at Advantest India Private Limited is regularly awarded. We never forget that it's the hard work and dedication of our people that wins our company recognition with our customers and within our industry. Working for Advantest is working for the leader in its class. Our employees are self-motivated and have come to expect competent leadership from our managers and executives.  
  
The Applications Engineer position delivers technical expertise for High Performance Compute device testing solution implementation to customer based on Advantest 93K products and services. It provides support for both pre-sales and post-sales assessment of customer needs as well as quick implementation/execution of the solution. You'll work on cutting edge technology working side by side with our customers in close collaboration with R&D and marketing in a cross-functional, international environment. This is an ideal position for a software or electrical engineer with a strong test engineering background, requiring both in depth knowledge of the V93000 system, as well as strong SW skills for writing test programs and tooling to meet customer needs.  
Responsibilities include:  

* Integrates Advantest products and services (at the system/solutions level) into customer's environment.
* Perform analysis of complex IC manufacturer customer requirements providing expertise on topics such as: Performance, Design, Utilization, Optimization, test program development/conversions and Implementation Strategies.
* Accountable for the design, scoping, and technical validity of the solution to achieve the customer's business objectives.
* Generate project plans for complex projects and track project completion for the technologies range from digital and high-speed SoC technologies.
* Create and deliver customer training classes and consultation materials.
* Communicate with customers relative to the completeness, repeatability, and accuracy of test programs. Review apparent issues and propose solutions as needed.
* Design Evaluation boards, Engineering and Production Load board for test and work with PCB designer to ensure all the best practices has been fulfilled.
* Define, develop, debug, and implement all major elements of electrical test programs for specific device types utilizing high-speed ATE and compliant test methodologies.
* Conduct experimental investigations as to test methodologies, test fixture design and development, product yield improvement, process quality controls, etc. Analyze experiment results and initiate / implement solutions.
* Provide technical analysis of related product issues and participate in the resolution of any issues found.

  
Requirements:

* Any Bachelor's Degree or equivalent from fully accredited college or university or master's degree in Electrical Engineering or Diploma in Electrical Electronics with Automated Test Equipment (ATE) knowledge is strongly desired.
    
  + Minimum 5-10 years of experience in an electrical/wireless testing of SoC Integrated Circuits in a Test Engineering role.
  + V93000 ATE test engineering experience
  + Knowledge and experience on test program development for the V93000 using SmarTest 7 and SmarTest 8 and Test Method coding
  + Understanding of Integrated Device Parameters, Test Philosophy, High Speed Digital fundamentals, PA fundamentals, industry standard test

**Summary**
-----------


As an Advisor Contracts at Gainwell, you will serve as an individual contributor responsible for leading the development, negotiation, interpretation and administration of complex contracts and associated governance across the enterprise. This role partners closely with legal, procurement, HR, and business stakeholders to manage contractual risk, ensure regulatory compliance, and drive standardized contract practices that support organizational and client objectives.


We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Advisor Contracts to support a U.S.\-based healthcare technology and services organization focused on contracts with vendors, state and local governments as well as commercial entities. This role will be responsible for independently managing complex commercial, healthcare, technology, vendor, and government\-related contracts throughout the contracting lifecycle.


The ideal candidate will possess exceptional English communication skills, strong contract interpretation and negotiation experience, sound business judgment, and the ability to operate independently while partnering closely with U.S.\-based legal, sales, procurement, delivery, and executive teams.


**Your role in our mission**
----------------------------


When joining Gainwell, you will:


* Draft, review, negotiate, and manage a wide variety of agreements, including:


* Master Services Agreements (MSAs)
* Statements of Work (SOWs)
* Amendments and Change Orders
* Non\-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs)
* Teaming Agreements
* Software, SaaS, and technology agreements
* Vendor and subcontractor agreements
* State, local and commercial healthcare\-related services agreements
* Lead contract negotiations with customers, vendors, subcontractors, and business partners.


* Analyze contractual risks and develop practical risk\-mitigation strategies.


* Interpret contract provisions and provide clear guidance to internal legal, contracts and business stakeholders regarding rights, obligations, and compliance requirements.


* Provide advice to and collaborate with U.S.\-based contract managers, attorneys and business leaders to resolve legal, commercial, operational, and compliance issues.


* Support proposal, bid, and procurement activities, including leading contract reviews associated with RFPs and government healthcare opportunities.


* Manage contracts for compliance with corporate policies, applicable laws, healthcare regulations, privacy requirements, and contracting standards.


* Maintain accurate contract records and manage contracts through contract lifecycle management systems.


* Track key contractual obligations, deliverables, renewals, notices, and expiration dates.


* Provide training and guidance to internal stakeholders on contract processes and risk management.


* Build strong working relationships with internal and external business partners and serve as a trusted advisor to the business.


**What we're looking for**
--------------------------


* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience; advanced degree (e.g., JD or MBA) preferred


* 15\-18 years of experience in contracts management, legal operations, or related fields


* Strong knowledge of US contract law, regulatory compliance, and risk management principles


* Proven ability to independently assess, review, negotiate and manage complex agreements and influence senior stakeholders


* Demonstrated ability to identify, interpret, summarize contractual terms and explain legal and business implications to non\-legal stakeholders.


* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, organization, decision\-marking and stakeholder management skills


* Demonstrated experience analyzing and summarizing complex contracts with minimal supervision.


* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with U.S.\-based executives and legal professionals.


* Experience managing multiple priorities and meeting demanding deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.


* Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal supervision while exercising sound judgment.


* Mastery of Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and contract lifecycle management tools.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Years of experience supporting U.S. healthcare, healthcare technology, managed care, health plan, or Medicaid\-related contracts.


* Strong familiarity with healthcare privacy, data security, compliance, and regulatory requirements.


* Demonstrated experience supporting U.S. state government contracts, healthcare procurements, or large\-scale outsourcing agreements.


* Experience working within a multinational or global organization supporting U.S.\-based operations.


**Competencies**


* Proven contract drafting, review and negotiation capabilities


* Independent contract interpretation and issue spotting


* Executive\-level communication skills


* Business acumen and commercial judgment


* Risk assessment and mitigation


* Significant attention to detail


* Customer\-focused mindset


* Ability to influence without direct authority


* Self\-starter with strong ownership mentality


**What you should expect in this role**
---------------------------------------

title: Admissions Manager/Executive
description:
**Admissions Manager/Executive**

About Greenvalley Kriyaalaya International School

Greenvalley Kriyaalaya is a school and community of passionate individuals committed to reimagining education and creating meaningful change in society.

We are among the pioneers in personalised education, with an individualised learning plan for every child. Our approach is designed around understanding each child's strengths, interests, learning needs and aspirations rather than treating every child the same.

We are now expanding our presence and are looking for energetic, articulate and highly driven people to join our core team and play a key role in building the school's parent community.

This is a **role** that requires strong communication, presentation, relationship\-building and follow\-up skills.

**Role Summary**

As an Admissions team member, you will be responsible for taking prospective parents through the complete admissions journey — from the first interaction and enquiry to school visit, counselling, follow\-up and final admission.

You will be one of the most important faces of Greenvalley Kriyaalaya to prospective families.

The ideal candidate should be someone who can speak confidently to a room full of parents, conduct engaging presentations and workshops, understand what parents are looking for, communicate the school's value convincingly, build trust, handle objections and consistently convert enquiries into admissions.

This role requires a strong sales mindset, excellent people skills and exceptional follow\-up discipline.

**Key Responsibilities1\. Parent Counselling \& Admissions Sales**

* Handle enquiries from prospective parents and understand their child's educational needs, expectations and concerns.
* Present Greenvalley Kriyaalaya's philosophy, personalised learning approach, programmes and differentiators in a clear and compelling manner.
* Conduct one\-to\-one counselling sessions with parents and guide them through the decision\-making process.
* Understand parent objections and concerns and respond with confidence, empathy and appropriate solutions.
* Take ownership of prospective parents through the complete admissions funnel — enquiry → counselling → school visit → application → admission.
* Follow up consistently with prospective families and move them towards a decision.
* Maintain strong relationships with prospective parents throughout the admissions journey.
* Achieve defined admissions and conversion targets.

**2\. Presentations, Workshops \& Parent Engagement**

* Conduct engaging presentations for groups of prospective parents.
* Represent the school at parent meetings, community events, exhibitions, workshops and outreach programmes.
* Conduct or assist in workshops on education, parenting, child development, personalised learning and related topics.
* Speak confidently to small and large groups and create enthusiasm and curiosity about the school.
* Deliver presentations that are informative, persuasive and aligned with the school's philosophy.
* Represent Greenvalley Kriyaalaya professionally at external events and community interactions.

**3\. Lead Generation \& Community Outreach**

* Identify and develop opportunities to generate quality admission enquiries.
* Participate in community outreach activities including RWA programmes, events, exhibitions, roadshows, school fairs, seminars and other relevant activities.
* Build relationships with communities, parent groups, organisations and other potential sources of admissions.
* Work closely with the marketing team to convert campaigns and outreach activities into qualified admission leads.
* Proactively identify new opportunities for reaching prospective parents.

**4\. Lead Management \& Follow\-up**

* Maintain an accurate and updated database of prospective parents.
* Ensure every enquiry receives timely and appropriate follow\-up.
* Track each prospective family through the admissions pipeline.
* Maintain detailed records of parent interactions, requirements, objections, next steps and follow\-up dates.
* Demonstrate excellent follow\-up discipline and the ability to remember important details about prospective families.
* Ensure that no promising lead is lost due to delayed or inadequate follow\-up.
* Regularly review conversion rates and identify opportunities to improve the admissions process.

**5\. School Tours \& Conversion**

* Personally conduct or coordinate school tours for prospective parents and children.
* Create a warm and memorable experience for visiting families.
* Understand the family's priorities and connect the school's facilities, learning environment and approach to their specific needs.
* Follow up after school visits and guide families towards the next stage of admission.

**6\. Internal Coordination**

* Coordinate with academic, administrative and marketing teams to ensure a smooth admissions experience.
* Ensure prospective parents receive accurate information and timely responses.
* Coordinate admission documentation and application processes.
* Provide regular updates on lead status, admissions pipeline and conversion performance.
* Contribute ideas to continuously improve the admissions process and parent experience.

**Essential Skills**

* Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong presentation and public\-speaking ability.
* Ability to confidently address groups of parents and conduct workshops.
* Strong consultative selling and persuasion skills.
* Ability to understand customer needs and build trust quickly.
* Strong objection\-handling and negotiation skills.
* Excellent follow\-up discipline.
* Ability to manage multiple prospective families simultaneously.
* Strong memory and attention to details about customers and conversations.
* High energy, enthusiasm and a positive attitude.
* Target\-oriented and comfortable working towards measurable admission goals.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of results.
* Professional appearance, confidence and maturity when interacting with parents.
* Willingness to work at events and during occasional weekends when required.

**Experience \& Qualifications**

**Education:** Graduate in any discipline.

**Experience:** 4–6 years of experience in sales, admissions, counselling, business development, customer\-facing roles or related fields.

Candidates with experience in **school admissions, education, premium retail, hospitality, real estate, banking, financial services, technology or other consultative sales environments** may be considered.

Experience in the education sector is an advantage but is **not mandatory**.

Candidates must demonstrate a proven ability to interact with customers, generate interest, build relationships and achieve conversions.

**Personal Qualities**

We are looking for someone who is:

* **Highly energetic**
* **Confident and articulate**
* **Warm and approachable**
* **A strong listener**
* **Target\-driven**
* **Persistent with follow\-ups**
* **Organised and detail\-oriented**
* **Comfortable speaking in front of groups**
* **Passionate about education**
* **Eager to learn and grow**
* **Able to represent the school's values with authenticity**

Position Summary

The Executive Assistant (EA) to the MD provides high\-level administrative, coordination, and confidential support to the Managing Director, ensuring smooth day\-to\-day functioning of the MD's office. The role requires strong organizational skills, discretion, and the ability to liaise across departments, external stakeholders, and senior management on the MD's behalf.

Key Roles \& Responsibilities1\. Calendar \& Schedule Management

* Manage the MD's daily calendar, appointments, meetings, and travel schedules.
* Prioritize and coordinate meeting requests, avoiding conflicts and ensuring optimal use of the MD's time.
* Proactively remind the MD of upcoming commitments, deadlines, and follow\-up actions.
* Reschedule/reorganize meetings as priorities shift, keeping all stakeholders informed.

2\. Communication \& Correspondence

* Draft, review, and manage emails, letters, memos, and official communication on behalf of the MD.
* Screen and prioritize incoming calls, emails, and messages, routing them appropriately or handling directly where possible.
* Act as the first point of contact between the MD and internal/external stakeholders (employees, clients, vendors, government bodies).
* Ensure timely and professional responses to communications requiring the MD's attention.

3\. Meeting Coordination \& Documentation

* Organize internal and external meetings — scheduling, venue/logistics, agenda preparation, and participant coordination.
* Attend meetings with the MD (as required), take minutes, and track action items to closure.
* Prepare meeting briefs, background notes, and presentation materials in advance of key meetings.
* Follow up with respective departments/individuals to ensure action items from meetings are executed on time.

4\. Travel \& Logistics Management

* Plan and coordinate the MD's domestic and international travel — flights, accommodation, visas, and itineraries.
* Prepare detailed travel schedules and ensure all logistics (transport, meetings, documents) are in place.
* Handle travel\-related expense reports and reimbursements.

5\. Coordination with Departments \& Stakeholders

* Liaise with department heads (Sales, Procurement, Production, Quality, Finance, HR) to gather updates, reports, and information required by the MD.
* Follow up on pending approvals, decisions, and action items across departments on behalf of the MD.
* Coordinate with external stakeholders — clients, auditors, consultants, government officials, and business partners — as directed by the MD.
* Represent the MD's office in routine coordination matters, ensuring consistency in communication.

6\. Reports, Presentations \& Documentation

* Prepare reports, presentations, and dashboards (MIS, sales, procurement, production summaries) for the MD's review.
* Consolidate inputs from various departments into concise, decision\-ready formats.
* Maintain organized records/files of important documents, contracts, correspondence, and MD's approvals.
* Ensure confidentiality and secure handling of sensitive business and personal documents.

7\. Confidentiality \& Special Assignments

* Handle confidential and sensitive information (business strategy, financials, HR matters) with utmost discretion.
* Support the MD in special projects, research, or ad\-hoc assignments as required.
* Assist in personal administrative matters/errands for the MD, where applicable.
* Anticipate the MD's needs and proactively resolve issues before escalation.

8\. Office \& Vendor Coordination

* Coordinate with admin/office teams to ensure the MD's office runs smoothly (supplies, equipment, facilities).
* Liaise with vendors/service providers engaged directly by the MD's office (travel agents, event organizers, etc.).
* Manage petty cash/expenses related to the MD's office, ensuring proper documentation.

Required Skills \& Competencies

* Strong organizational, multitasking, and time\-management abilities.
* High level of discretion, integrity, and professionalism in handling confidential matters.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and calendar/scheduling tools.

* Ability to work under pressure, manage last\-minute changes, and multitask across priorities.
* Proactive, detail\-oriented, and solution\-driven approach.

Chemelex is a global leader in electric thermal and sensing solutions, protecting the world’s critical processes, places and people. With over 50 years of innovation and a commitment to excellence, we develop solutions that ensure safety, reliability, and efficiency in diverse environments – from industrial plants and data centers to people’s homes. We deliver future\-ready technologies, advanced engineering capabilities and local expertise backed by global standards. Our offering includes a leading portfolio from our trusted brands: Raychem, Tracer, Nuheat and Pyrotenax.
  
  

Chemelex is looking for people who put their innovation, strengths, and passion to work to advance our and their own success. Join an organization with decades of experiences successfully executed projects and services under the brand names RAYCHEM and TRACER that ensures a more secure world through connecting and protecting our customers with inventive electrical solutions.
  
  

**What You Will Experience In This Position:**  

This position is a highly sophisticated sales role serving various industries like the traditional oil \& gas, chemicals, pharmaceutical, power, Paint, FMCG and F\&B. The role will involve selling electrical heat tracing and thermal management products, services and projects either direct to End\-Users or through a variety of different channels , e.g. Specialist Distributor, Wholesaler, Reps. and projects through Contractors like EPC houses.
  
You will be responsible for developing our local industrial product/projects business, MRO and distributor business for India Region. You will report to the India Industrial Heat Tracing Sales Manager.
  
  

Strategic Responsibilities and Activities
  
* Develop and implement a strategy for the India Region in line with the current regional Industrial Heat Tracing business strategy, which has been created in a combination of direct product \& local project business based on value selling and always looking for Upselling possibilities.
* Protect strategic relationships while increasing regional hunting capacity.


Organize around customer ownership and buying behavior not only state boundaries.
  
* Engage EPCs early because design\-in and approved\-vendor status often determine downstream order capture.
* Create repeatable cross\-selling motions across heat tracing, tank insulation and industrial leak detection systems (hydrocarbon/ chemicals etc.)
* Build coverage across South and East India; develop PSU, EPC, private industrial and small\-industry opportunities; create a new regional funnel.
* Develop a strong focus on Upselling to each client request by understanding clients’ needs and identifying the hidden demands through the concept of Value Selling.
* Your focus will be on the Industrial Bizz and thus customers (direct) and actively support efforts related to the industrial product business which is handled by Wholesalers and our partners in India.


Process and Focus areas
  
* Implement a workflow for the regional upselling.
* Priority segments: South/East EPCs, PSU oil and energy customers, large private industrial groups, ports, terminals, chemicals, steel, mining, power and process industries.
* Create the territory from the ground up: map installed base, industrial belts, consultants, EPCs, distributors/influencers and active capex projects.
* Build a qualified funnel that is balanced between large project pursuits and shorter\-cycle retrofit/replacement business. Focus on IHS MRO, products, small project business and channel partner management.
* Generate and qualify opportunities from new projects, steam\-to\-electric conversions, brownfield upgrades, maintenance/replacement needs and tank/terminal projects.
* Lead the commercial process from discovery through proposal, negotiation, order booking and handover to execution.
* Work with applications/technical teams to translate customer requirements into technically sound, differentiated proposals.
* Influence specifications and approved\-vendor lists before RFQ release; build references and application case studies.
* Set up account plans for the key accounts \& Partners
* Identify and qualify project opportunities and capture these in Salesforce;
* Use and apply PriceFX for all product quotations and making sure all customers have a pricing agreement or fit in a certain pricing matrix.
* Develop and track actions and activities associated to identified opportunities and account plans.
* Deliver seminars, trainings and face to face meeting at key customer groups / partners on a defined basis.
* In projects of choice and key accounts try to secure strong technical specifications (embedding).
* Build relationships with EPC contractors, consultants, PSU project teams, plant engineering, maintenance, procurement and project management.
* Maintain existing client relationships by promoting new products, services and special applications;
* Report competitor activities, review regional threats, consider any hurdles to success and propose an action plan to overcome.


Skill\- and Mindset
  
* Be an early adaptor and active promoter of Value Selling.
* Creative, innovative, out of the box thinking, curious and interested, positive energy.
* Through a consultative sales approach, deliver additional value and grow scope by providing our customers with specialized solutions and turnkey services.
* Successfully close the final contract negotiations with customers and act as an executive sponsor during the execution of projects to optimize client relationships, project revenue and profitability.
* Provide regular updates in Salesforce and make it your ultimate daily tool.
* Promote new innovative solutions to both existing and new clients including end users, consultants and other stakeholders via frequent direct customer visits.


Metrics
  
* Follow up quarterly with your line manager on agreed actions, approach and create counter measurements;
* Provide sales forecasts, and activity reports. Maintain project information in CRM system, ensuring regular/weekly follow\-up on all open sales prospects and quotations;
* Analyze your hit rate, review, and take actions;
* Follow the Price realization metrics;
* Set and agree upon the Annual sales and profit targets.


**You Have:**  

* 8–15 years of industrial B2B sales experience in process industries, electrical/thermal solutions, insulation, instrumentation, leak detection, MRO or engineered project solutions.
* Demonstrated experience selling through EPCs and into operating companies, preferably in oil \& gas, petrochemicals, chemicals, power, terminals, steel, mining, pharma or related process industries.
* Experience with long sales cycles, technical specifications, approved\-vendor processes, tenders and project procurement.
* Strong commercial judgment: can qualify opportunities, protect value, manage margins and negotiate with multiple stakeholders.
* Comfort with independent territory building and frequent travel; able to work with technical teams without needing to be the design engineer.
* Strong written and verbal communication in English; Hindi and/or a South Indian language is advantageous.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business or a related discipline preferred.
* Highly motivated and self\-driven individual focused on achieving results;


Strong market knowledge and relationships with end users/contractors associated with the refinery, oil \& gas, chemicals, petrochemicals, pharmaceutical, FMCG, Paint, F\&B, Manufacturing units and power within India region;
  
* Ability to interpret information and produce reports;
* Demonstrable experience of using initiative and working with deadlines as well as being target driven with prioritizing in the right manner;
* Experience of using Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Word and Excel) and Salesforce.


**Preferred qualifications:**  

* Basic knowledge of electrical heat tracing or low voltage electrical power distribution
* Detailed knowledge of one or more of the following fields Traditional Oil \& Gas, Refining, Petrochemical, Chemical processing, Power Generation and Utilities industries.

Pioneering plants, sprawling data centers, busy transport hubs, and your own home. These are the places that bring progress to the world, and the places that we protect with time\-tested technologies, advanced engineering, and a suite of services. Because here, excellence is everything.
